args.sql:
WITH TopPositions AS (
    SELECT 
        rm.riskandmarginpivot, 
        o.notionsum AS notional_value, 
        ms.volmeter AS volatility_measure, 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'inithold' AS initial_margin, 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'mainthold' AS maintenance_margin, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.notionsum DESC) AS position_rank
    FROM 
        riskandmargin rm
    JOIN 
        orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
    JOIN 
        marketstats ms ON rm.riskandmarginpivot = ms.marketstatsmark
    WHERE 
        rm.risk_margin_profile->>'possum' IS NOT NULL 
        AND o.notionsum IS NOT NULL 
        AND ms.volmeter IS NOT NULL
),
PVaRCalculation AS (
    SELECT 
        riskandmarginpivot, 
        notional_value, 
        volatility_measure, 
        initial_margin, 
        maintenance_margin, 
        (
            (notional_value * volatility_measure) - 
            (initial_margin + maintenance_margin)
        ) AS pvar
    FROM 
        TopPositions
    WHERE 
        position_rank <= 5
)
SELECT 
    pvar AS risk_and_margin_pivot, 
    notional_value, 
    volatility_measure, 
    pvar AS calculated_pvar
FROM 
    PVaRCalculation;
